Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000134": The job scheduler is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000180" [decision]: The Ember team does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000379": The Cinder team observed that after the cache change, the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Cinder team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000177" [constraint]: The job scheduler deploys only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000103" [decision]: Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000422" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000279": Team Dune observed that after the cache change, the notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000092": The Ember team is currently a one-person team consisting of Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000351": As of 2025-04-24, the Cinder team reported that feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Cinder team, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000334" [decision]: Team Dune adopted a monthly game day.  (about: team Dune)
- memory_id "1000174" [decision]: Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000171": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000386": On 2025-05-15, Oskar walked Lena through the webhook dispatcher runbook as part of the handover.  (about: Lena, webhook dispatcher, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000183": The job scheduler needs the feature-flags service for per-job kill switches.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000227": The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change, and the Boreal team noticed and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000426" [decision]: Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager this cycle as of 2025-06-06, taking over from Diego.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder team, Diego)
- memory_id "1000251": As of 2025-03-07, the billing API is owned by the Ember team.  (about: billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000167": The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during incident INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000390": As of 2025-05-15, the webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000356" [decision]: Marcus Oyelaran takes the pager rotation for the Boreal team as of 2025-05-07, taking over from Lena Fischer.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
